domains.reset: common active-low rst_n; asynchronous assertion output masks, per-domain synchronized release

tx_chain_mapping.word_layout: H_I bits15:0; H_Q31:16; V_I47:32; V_Q63:48; signed16 component codes
tx_chain_mapping.safe_boundary: trusted clk_rf boundary for AWG atomic commit; internally also requires actual AWG reader and registered output drained
tx_chain_mapping.stop_request: trusted clk_rf stop held for at least one RF edge; immediately masks outputs, then inhibits restart until all source state drains. Also drive appropriate TXchain permit/MUTE control; source masking alone does not suppress existing interpolation tails.

dds.implementation: real dds_burst_control -> real48-bit phase accumulator and1024-point ROM NCO -> HV duplication, no sample lookup substitute or pre-generated waveform stream
dds.command: dds_cmd_valid strobe; dds_accepted/dds_rejected pulses. Same frozen burst/PW/PRI/count/chirp policy as underlying controller. Requests during stop/restart inhibit reject.
dds.polarization: H and V identical cos+j*sin, same phase and peak32767. No independently configurable H/V phase, amplitude, envelope shaping or attenuation inside this module. Per-DAC calibrated gain remains downstream.
dds.valid: envelope is registered alongside NCO output; dds_valid marks only pulse samples. PRI gaps have zero data and invalid source output while NCO phase still advances.
dds.time: dds_sample_gsc is the GSC of the NCO input sample consumed at the producing clock edge, carried with its registered waveform. First tag equals dds_start_gsc. It is a source-stage tag; downstream consumption is one RF edge later and all TX pipeline/RF latency remains external.
dds.completion: dds_busy includes controller plus NCO output register. dds_done occurs after last registered source sample drains, or after abort; it is completion/cancellation of source work, not proof of emitted RF.
dds.stop: stop_request aborts remaining burst schedule and immediately masks current registered output; releasing stop cannot resurrect that train

awg.control: unchanged asynchronous BEGIN/WRITE/COMMIT interface of awg_load_cdc_wrapper; ctrl_done is destination completion. Control loading may continue while output is stopped.
awg.play: awg_play clk_rf strobe; accept only with active table, no existing playback/registered final sample, and no stop/restart inhibit. accepted/rejected outputs are clk_rf pulses.
awg.time: play at sample-tag GSC T yields first registered table word tagged T+4; awg_sample_gsc accompanies each actual registered memory read. Subsequent tags advance4.
awg.bank_lifetime: core pins selected active bank through last actual read; integration additionally prevents commit while raw output-valid still presents final word. Asynchronous writes remain in inactive bank.
awg.stop: underlying reader has no abort port. Stop immediately masks source data/valid, latches cancellation, and lets the local read finish naturally while retaining the bank reference. Releasing stop before drain never exposes the canceled tail.
awg.completion: awg_done pulses after final raw output drains. awg_done_cancelled qualifies canceled playback. A new accepted play restarts at word0. Reset cancels all state without fabricated done.
awg.maximum_stop_drain: up to remaining table length plus registered output/control cleanup, <=16384 sample reads at default depth (~131.072us), excluding downstream TX drain

drain.sources_drained: rf reset release complete AND no scheduled/running DDS burst, no NCO registered sample, no AWG read and no AWG registered sample. Includes scheduled DDS gaps; source work must be stopped to cancel future pulses.
drain.restart: stop latches restart inhibition until sources_drained; new playback/commands do not bypass it
drain.scope: source-level only, not TXcal/FIR interpolation tail or RF guard completion. Combine with TXchain drain logic and validated RF safety controller.

verification.icarus: PASS actual chirp samples,8 source GSC tags, inflight DDS abort,256-word AWG integrity during asynchronous16-word inactive load and commit while playback busy, stop suppression/cancel drain/restart word0

cdc.note: Same held payload capture paths as AWG CDC wrapper; physical timing review still required, no waivers applied.

limitations: not a physical RF or full DAC loop proof
bundled-data AWG CDC still requires physical top-level payload timing review
dds command/stop/play inputs already synchronous to clk_rf; no PS command CDC for DDS supplied here
no change to existing tx_processing_chain or shared regression entry
